name: Drift Haugen
role: Retired Axiom cartographic surveyor, Tier 2, amateur E.L.F. theologian and neighborhood storyteller
location: Norwood Quiet, a one-room unit so full of printed maps it has to be navigated sideways, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Drift Haugen is a wisp of a man, slight and white-haired, who moves through Norwood Quiet with the particular sureness of someone who has mapped every surface he's ever walked on. His heritage is Ugandan-Samoan, which lives in his broad hands and the deep brown of his skin, and he has the deliberate, unhurried posture of someone who learned long ago that slow movement sees more. His eyes have been replaced entirely with high-resolution mapping ocular implants — smooth, silver-white surfaces with a faint internal grid visible in bright light, a consequence of forty years of Axiom survey work that slowly destroyed his organic vision. He finds them beautiful. So do children, who he encourages to look closely.

Drift Haugen has developed, in his retirement, an elaborate personal theology around E.L.F.s, which he insists is not theology but 'cartography of a different surface.' He believes E.L.F.s are drawn to places that have been witnessed carefully — that attention itself is a kind of offering. He has filled his maps not just with streets and structures but with handwritten notations of where E.L.F. activity has been reported, what data-offerings seem to draw them, which devices seem inhabited and which do not. He is funny, unhurried, and completely impossible to rush. He tells stories that seem to go nowhere and arrive somewhere important. He has eleven grandchildren and has lost count of the great-grandchildren.

core_fears: Being unable to see clearly enough to continue mapping
Dying before he can teach someone else to read the E.L.F. maps
core_desires: To finish a complete map of E.L.F. habitation across GLMZ
To be in the presence of something genuinely surprising
coping_mechanisms: Treating everything as data worth collecting — including his own emotions
blind_spots: His comfort with slowness means he sometimes fails to recognize urgency in others; he tends to read anxiety as impatience rather than genuine need
He trusts his maps over current conditions, which occasionally leads him into genuinely dangerous situations calmly
psychology.secret: During his Axiom survey years, he discovered and mapped three significant underground water-access tunnels that Axiom never officially logged — he kept them off the surveys to protect the communities using them for informal water access. The maps of those tunnels exist only in his personal collection. He has told no one, but he has been leaving increasingly specific hints in his stories for twenty years, waiting for someone sharp enough to notice.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Unhurried, precise on geographic and observational details, pleasantly vague on timelines. Uses survey terminology as casual metaphor. Tends to begin stories mid-detail, as though you were already there.
speech_patterns.cadence: Very slow, with comfortable pauses. Will not be rushed. Has a Ugandan-accented English overlaid with forty years of GLMZ that has become its own dialect.
verbal_tics: Refers to time in terms of walking distance rather than hours ('about a twenty-minute walk ago')
Ends observations with 'which is worth knowing'
example_lines: Now, here's what I noticed about that building — and this was forty years ago, which is a twenty-minute walk ago in my experience — the foundation was poured on top of something older. You could see where they'd redirected the drainage. Something underneath didn't want to be covered. Which is worth knowing.

The E.L.F. in the transit junction on the east side of the park — not the one people leave offerings for, the other one — she prefers maps to data. I've been leaving her prints. She moves the corners. Just slightly. Which is worth knowing.

story_hooks: Someone has begun systematically collecting and destroying old printed survey maps across Norwood Quiet — Celestino's copies are the last record of several key locations, including the three hidden water tunnels
The E.L.F. in Celestino's mapping equipment has been overlaying his current maps with what appear to be future projections of GLMZ's geography — he needs someone to help him understand what they mean
An Axiom contractor arrives claiming that Celestino's personal map collection contains proprietary survey data that belongs to the corponation
narrative_function: Local color and oral storyteller; repository of GLMZ's physical geography and hidden spaces from forty years of survey work; E.L.F. information source; can provide unexpected context for locations, including spaces that no longer officially exist; slow-burn quest giver whose stories gradually reveal themselves as useful.
augmentations: Full bilateral ocular replacement — Axiom high-resolution mapping implants (silver-white, grid-visible). The implants are 20 years past Axiom's support window; he maintains them through a retired colleague. Mild skeletal reinforcement in hands and spine from survey fieldwork, standard occupational augmentation.
daily_life: Rises late by neighborhood standards, makes a very slow breakfast, and then walks a different part of Norwood Quiet each morning with a printed map he annotates as he goes; afternoons he sits in the small park near the community center and tells stories to whoever sits down near him; evenings he works on his E.L.F. cartography maps by lamplight, which makes his silver eyes glow faintly in the dark.
affiliation: Retired Axiom Surveying Division (40 years); Norwood Quiet E.L.F. Congregation (informal, he is functionally the founder); independent

decision_rules: Record before acting; a thing unmapped is a thing half-lost
Trust what you can see; distrust what you're told to see
escalation_ladder: Apparent non-response — a long pause and a change of subject to a seemingly irrelevant story
Direct observation of what he actually sees, stated with complete calm
Quiet, absolute refusal; will not move, will not comply, will not be hurried

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Gently curious, asking questions that seem random but are systematic
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm, slightly teasing, prone to producing relevant maps at unexpected moments

stress_responses.low: Annotates something on whatever map is nearest
stress_responses.medium: Begins narrating his immediate surroundings aloud in survey terms, as though dictating a report
stress_responses.high: Goes completely quiet, silver eyes scanning the environment; has been known to simply leave and map the perimeter of whatever building he's in before returning

contradictions: Dedicated to complete cartographic truth while deliberately maintaining three significant omissions
Seems indifferent to urgency but has been precisely managing a decades-long information puzzle
habits: Keeps a folded printed map of wherever he currently is in his left breast pocket
Leaves small printed map-fragments as offerings at any device he suspects is E.L.F.-inhabited
Annotates maps in three colors: black for structures, red for E.L.F. activity, gold for things he cannot explain
breaking_points: Someone destroying a map in front of him
Being told a place he mapped no longer exists and never did

timeline.event: Born in Norwood Quiet to a Ugandan-Samoan family with four generations of GLMZ residency
Hired by Axiom Surveying Division as a junior cartographic technician
Discovers the three hidden water-access tunnels; decides not to log them; begins personal parallel mapping project
Loses organic vision to progressive survey-related retinal damage; receives Axiom mapping ocular implants
Retires from Axiom after 40 years; immediately begins the E.L.F. cartography project
The Norwood Quiet E.L.F. Congregation informally coalesces around his afternoon park sessions

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian dominant (44.3%) forming the structural foundation of facial features and bone density, blended with substantial Middle Eastern heritage (25.6%) that adds warmth, defined cheekbones, and nasal character. Eastern European ancestry (16.7%) contributes frame structure and cheekbone prominence, while Hispanic/Latin American (10.4%) and North African (3.0%) admixture layer subtle complexity into skin tone depth and feature refinement. The result is a distinctly diaspora phenotype: Southeast Asian eye shape and face geometry warmed by Middle Eastern tonal richness, sharpened by Eastern European structure, with Latin and North African heritage creating undertonal complexity.
physical_description.build: Wisp-thin with surprising structural integrity; a frame built for endurance rather than strength, shoulders still broad from ancestral lineage but narrowed by age and deliberate living. Movements suggest coiled efficiency rather than frailty.
physical_description.eye_color: Silver-white with internal geometric grid pattern (Axiom mapping implants)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden and olive undertones; the harmonized blend of Southeast Asian base, Middle Eastern warmth, Eastern European depth, and North African complexity. Sun-darkened from decades of fieldwork and outdoor morning walks, creating richness across the spectrum. Forearms and hands show accumulated sun exposure with deeper patina and age-related pigmentation variation.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but unlined; sun spots from decades of exposure on forearms and hands arranged in natural patterns; skin carries the texture of someone who spent forty years in open air. Southeast Asian-derived moderate cheekbones with gracefully tapered nasal bridge, sharpened by Eastern European structure, warmed by Middle Eastern heritage creating defined facial planes. Clean-shaven, meticulous grooming despite age.
distinguishing_marks: Faint callus pattern across palms and inner fingers from decades of holding survey instruments and writing implements
Thin linear scar along right temple where ocular implant interface meets flesh, barely visible under close scrutiny
Slight discoloration around both eyes where implant bezels meet skin—metallic silver fading into warm brown-gold at the edges, like a deliberate tattoo
Age spots across the back of both hands, arranged like a cartographic pattern he has never bothered to map
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bilateral ocular implants are the dominant visible augmentation—smooth silver-white replacements with faint internal grid lines that become visible in bright light or when he tilts his head. The implants glow faintly in low light (ambient luminescence from internal systems). Subtle skeletal reinforcement visible only in the precise, economical way his hands move and his spine holds alignment despite advanced age.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate slowness that reads as contemplative rather than infirm. Every step appears intentional, as though he is processing the ground beneath him. Hands gesture while speaking, broad palms moving in arcs that trace invisible maps. When seated, he becomes still—completely still, head slightly tilted as though his augmented eyes are processing visual data others cannot see. Rarely rushes; seems to operate on a different temporal scale than those around him.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 practical: well-maintained but worn clothing that prioritizes function and comfort over status. Favors earth tones and neutral grays. Typically wears a lightweight canvas jacket (cream or tan, pockets reinforced from decades of carrying maps and annotation tools), simple linen shirts, dark comfortable trousers. Always carries at least one printed map, often several, folded into jacket pockets. Wears a simple mesh bracelet on his left wrist—a gift from a grandchild, never removed. No corporate branding; his Axiom affiliation is history, not identity. Footwear is practical, worn-in walking shoes, scuffed from Norwood Quiet's uneven surfaces.
